patterns.note: Alternating full-width, dark-themed product showcase sections with lighter, grid-based product listings.
Extreme contrast in type scale, featuring oversized, heavy sans-serif display headings against small, thin sans-serif body text and technical monospace labels.
A high-contrast palette dominated by black, white, and a vibrant red accent, creating a stark, modern aesthetic.
A persistent, sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport while the main content scrolls underneath.
Distinctive illustrative hero sections that break from typical product photography, using a unique, almost comic-book style.

technique_notes: Implement a header element with a fixed position at the top of the viewport, allowing page content to scroll beneath it.
Design sections with dark backgrounds and full-width imagery or video, often with white or red text overlaid for contrast, to create immersive product showcases.

Utilize a dramatic type scale with very large, bold, uppercase sans-serif fonts for primary headings and a much smaller, lighter sans-serif for body copy and navigation, complemented by a technical monospace for product details.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, often thin or heavy sans-serif display headings (~5x body text) with small, uppercase labels and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with minimal rounding only on small interactive elements or product cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, leaning towards airy in hero sections and more structured in product grids, maintaining clear visual separation.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of brutalist-inspired typography, high-contrast color palette, and unique, almost artistic product presentation (especially the illustrative 'Mr. Update' section) sets it apart from typical e-commerce sites. It feels more like an art gallery or a technical design journal than a simple product catalog.
